response.sql: WITH ct AS (SELECT CustomerId, SUM(Total) AS total FROM Invoice GROUP BY CustomerId), sh AS (SELECT CustomerId, total, total * 1.0 / SUM(total) OVER () AS share FROM ct), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM sh) SELECT AVG(sh.total) AS avg_spent, AVG(sh.share) AS avg_share, AVG(sh.share - a.avg_share) AS avg_excess_over_avg_share FROM sh, a WHERE sh.share > a.avg_share
